title: 第5章 蛋疼
content_zh:
天空之中，太阳自东边缓缓升起，晒下温暖的阳光，透过巨树的缝隙，点落在地上。

轩辕的额头部位，肿得老高，昨天夜里一连‘偷袭’了尹甄洛十七次，以完败收场，尹甄洛每一次都打在轩辕的额头上，故而才有了轩辕现在的满头包。

看着轩辕龇牙咧嘴的模样，尹甄洛感觉心情特别好，双手背在身后，圆润的双肩，精致的锁骨，给人的感觉，仿佛是世界上最精致的艺术品，缓缓走了几步路，白裙拖地，仿佛画中仙子般，此情此景，让轩辕看得再度有些着迷了。

在一旁的孤星，身上那银色的毛发，在太阳的照耀之下，散发出迷离的光彩，只见孤星，张开狼嘴，露出獠牙，打了一个大大的哈欠，白了轩辕一眼，似乎昨天晚上轩辕让它连觉都睡不好。

“在修炼之前，我想问一句，斗之一字，你是怎么理解的？”尹甄洛看着贼心不死，一双眼睛在自己身上游走的轩辕，微笑着问了一句。

“斗之一字，与人斗，与地斗，与天斗，其乐无穷。”

尹甄洛美眸之中，顿时绽放出异彩，她没想到轩辕竟然会说出这样的答案，让她有些吃惊，同时也有些欣喜，也许自己第一次收的徒儿，会是一个修炼中的天才也说不定，只要凭着这一股意志，修炼起来，自然事半功倍。

“好，好一个与人斗，与地斗，与天斗，其乐无穷，看来你的确适合走上修炼一途，若是像凡夫俗子般，日出而作，日落而息，只为三餐温饱，劳碌一生，不得解脱，等到老来归去，一抔黄土，几滴眼泪，也就了无痕迹了，这样未免太过可惜了。”尹甄洛言语轻柔如水，让轩辕很是享受，只是听到这里，轩辕淡淡地道了一句：

“是如果是我的话，估计也只能暴尸荒野，喂山林猛兽，怕是也没有人会为我流下几滴眼泪。”

“所以，你只能全心修炼了，不要辜负我对你的期待。”尹甄洛眸子里闪过一丝说不明的悸动，一头墨玉长发随风飘动，有一种说不出的灵气，只见尹甄洛的玉手陡然一震，一道强劲的破风声炸响，把轩辕给吓了一跳。

“寻常人的力量，最多只有一牛之力便已是难能可贵，算得上天生神力，斗之一道，第一个境界，为斗者，将斗者境界修炼到巅峰境界，能够将人的力量提升到九牛之力。”

听到尹甄洛开始说起关于修行的事，轩辕不再犯傻，而是听得极为专注，连忙问道：

“那超越了九牛之力之后是什么境界。”

“那就是斗士了，你不要好高骛远，斗者境界，寻常人想要修炼并不容易，在这一个境界，就是要炼透自己的皮肤，皮肤上有毛孔，没有修炼的人，毛孔淤塞，很难将天地之间的灵气，融入体内，等到年纪一大，壮年时期一过，便会逐渐老去，失去活力，而如果修炼到斗者境界，却是可以延缓衰老，又能够强身健体，延年益寿。”

尹甄洛知道，轩辕对于修炼一道，极为迷茫，所以也讲解得特别的仔细。

轩辕的领悟能力很好，一听就立刻明白了，尹甄洛这才继续说道：

“只有将自己全身上下的皮肤全部都炼得通透，可以吸收天地灵气之后，才能踏入斗士境界，凝聚斗气，然而想要修炼，就必须有神通手段，现在我传给你我尹家的《天龙炼鳞诀》，你好好看一下，看能够领悟得了多少！”

说完，尹甄洛手中就拿出了一片无比坚硬的龙鳞，金灿灿的，在上面布满了密密麻麻的蝇头小字。

轩辕接过金灿灿的龙鳞之后，将上面的内容看完之后，运转了起来，忽然感觉天地之间，好像有一股气息在突破自己的皮肤，有一种细微的刺痛。

尹甄洛没想到轩辕的领悟能力居然这么好，才一个小时不到，就已经能够以《天龙炼鳞诀》沟通天地之间的灵气，去冲击自己皮肤当中的毛孔了。

“美人师父，我已经有感觉了，全身刺刺麻麻的，是这种感觉，对吗？”轩辕感觉到非常的神奇，兴奋道。

“没错，就是这种感觉，既然你是我第一个教的徒弟，我也不能亏待你了，这是‘龙鳞粉’极为难得，你将这些‘龙鳞粉’洒在自己的身上，能够帮助你尽快冲开毛孔之中，杂质的淤塞，而且也能够在你的皮肤上，有一丝龙鳞的气息。”尹甄洛拿出了一道玉瓶，丢给了轩辕。

轩辕接过了玉瓶，将金灿灿的龙鳞交还给尹甄洛，尹甄洛只是摇了摇头，道：

“罢了，这个就当我送给你了，对我来讲，并没有大用，这一片龙鳞也能够卖不少钱，我并不能教你很久，不过如果你想把这一片龙鳞给卖了，记得要将上面的字给划掉。”

既然对于尹甄洛是无用之物，轩辕自然也就问心无愧地收下了，反正师父送徒弟东西，天经地义啊。

要是尹甄洛知道轩辕心里是这么想的恐怕也会气结，虽然这一片龙鳞上面的《天龙炼鳞诀》对她来讲已经没用了，但是这一片龙鳞的防护能力还是很好的，寻常武器根本破不开它的防御，价值不少。

轩辕将龙鳞很宝贝地塞进了自己的胸口后，这才抓起装着‘龙鳞粉’的玉瓶，带着淫、荡的笑意：

“美人师父，你帮我涂抹一下好不好？”

尹甄洛翻起了白眼，直接不想理轩辕了：

轩辕点了点头，倒也不在意，当即就在尹甄洛的面，脱下自己的衣服，赤条条的，让尹甄洛被迫偏过头去，身子侧过去了一半，只见其漂亮的脸蛋上浮出几丝红晕，毕竟说起来尹甄洛比起轩辕，也就大了两岁。

看着尹甄洛那露肩的白色连衣丝裙，将其衬托得玉颈欣长，身段说不出的风流，给人无限的遐想，轩辕吞了一口口水，道：

“这个要涂抹在身上的每一个地方吗？”

“当然。”尹甄洛气结，心里嗔了轩辕一句：“这家伙真不害臊。”

轩辕一丝不挂，将玉瓶之中的‘龙鳞粉’洒在自己的手中，感觉到手心一阵清凉，无比舒服，舒服得轩辕直哼哼地**了起来。

“你涂就涂吧，乱叫什么劲。”尹甄洛嗔怪道。

轩辕正在舒服的当口上，听得尹甄洛这么一说，人来疯了，更加变本加厉地**了起来：

尹甄洛的身子哆嗦了一下，无言以对，轩辕将全身上下都涂了一遍，看了看自己的下身，唯独这里没涂抹上，咕哝了一句：

“这里的皮肤应该也要炼透吧，唔，涂上就是。”

只见轩辕倒出了些许‘龙鳞粉’在手上，一把涂抹在自己的下身部位，一股清凉舒爽之意传达全身，登时，轩辕发自本心地**了起来。

“嗷…喔…雅蠛蝶……雅蠛蝶……”

听着轩辕**连连嘴里还含糊不清地吐出了几个自己听不懂的词语，尹甄洛越听越崩溃，想要狠狠地将轩辕捶死。

“你再敢乱叫的话，你就死定了。”尹甄洛身体再次哆嗦了一下，发出警告。

轩辕立马很识相的闭嘴，很麻利地穿起了衣服，盘膝坐在地上，一脸道貌岸然的模样，道：

“师父，我已经擦好了，我要开始修炼了，你不要打扰我。”

尹甄洛转过头来，看着轩辕一本正经的模样，气极，怒视了轩辕一眼之后，突然想起了什么，绝世容颜，笑颜如花，说不出的灿烂，已是一副准备看好戏的模样。

轩辕闭着双眼，自然看不清楚尹甄洛那精彩的表情，心中运转起了《天龙炼鳞诀》，只感觉到自己的皮肤毛孔一张一合，一股不少的天地灵气朝着自己冲刷而来，一股剧烈的刺痛感传遍了轩辕的全身。

轩辕只感觉到自己身体的毛孔，一个一个被撕开，仿佛被针扎的一样。

尹甄洛没想到，轩辕还真有几分硬气，这‘龙鳞粉’虽然起到辅助效果，但是却要忍受如被针扎般的痛苦，小时候自己也是经历过的，当时是咬着牙才没叫出来的，如今轩辕竟然连哼都不哼一声，实在难能可贵。

伴随着轩辕将《天龙炼鳞诀》自上而下，运转到下身的时候，轩辕的脸色顿时黑了下来，捂着自己的下身，抽搐了几下，倒在了一旁，痛呼了起来：

“师父，我蛋疼，我的蛋好疼，我的蛋疼死了……”
content_en:
In the sky, the sun slowly rose from the east, shining down warm sunlight that fell on the ground through the gaps in the giant trees.

Xuanyuan's forehead was so swollen that he had 'sneak attacks' on Yin Zhenluo seventeen times last night and ended in complete defeat. Yin Zhenluo hit Xuanyuan on the forehead every time, which is why Xuanyuan's head is full of bruises now.

Looking at Xuanyuan's grinning look, Yin Zhenluo felt particularly good. With his hands behind his back, his round shoulders and delicate collarbones made him feel like he was the most exquisite work of art in the world. He walked slowly for a few steps, his white skirt sweeping the floor, like a fairy in a painting. Xuanyuan was once again fascinated by this scene.

The silver hair on the side of Lone Star exuded a blurry brilliance under the sunlight. Lone Star opened its wolf mouth, exposed its fangs, yawned widely, and gave Xuanyuan a white look. It seemed that Xuanyuan couldn't sleep well last night.

"Before practicing, I would like to ask, how do you understand the word "fight"?" Yin Zhenluo asked with a smile as he looked at Xuanyuan, who was still obsessed with evil and his eyes were wandering around his body.

"The word "fight" means fighting with people, the earth, and the sky. The joy is endless."

Yin Zhenluo's beautiful eyes suddenly shone with brilliance. She didn't expect Xuanyuan to say such an answer, which made her a little surprised and a little happy at the same time. Maybe the disciple she accepted for the first time would be a genius in cultivation. As long as you practice with this will, you will get twice the result with half the effort.

"Okay, you have endless fun fighting with people, the earth, and the sky. It seems that you are indeed suitable to embark on the path of cultivation. If you are like an ordinary person, working at sunrise and resting at sunset, only for three meals and food and clothing, working hard all your life, there will be no liberation., when old age comes and goes, a handful of loess and a few tears will leave no trace.It would be a pity." Yin Zhenluo's words were as soft as water, which made Xuanyuan enjoy it very much. But when he heard this, Xuanyuan said lightly:

"If it were me, I would probably be left dead in the wilderness and fed to wild beasts in the forest. I'm afraid no one would shed a few tears for me."

"So, you can only practice wholeheartedly, and don't let me live up to my expectations of you." An inexplicable flutter flashed across Yin Zhenluo's eyes, and her long black jade hair fluttered in the wind, with an indescribable aura. Yin Zhenluo's jade hand suddenly shook, and a strong blast of wind exploded, startling Xuanyuan.

"The strength of an ordinary person is only the strength of an ox at most, which is very valuable. It can be regarded as a natural divine power. In the first realm of fighting, he is a fighter. Cultivating the realm of a fighter to the peak realm can increase a person's strength to the power of nine oxen."

When he heard Yin Zhenluo start talking about cultivation, Xuanyuan no longer acted foolishly, but listened very attentively and asked quickly:

"Then what is the state after surpassing the power of the Nine Bulls?"

"That's a fighter. Don't be too ambitious. In the realm of a fighter, it's not easy for ordinary people to practice. In this realm, you have to refine your own skin. There are pores on the skin. For people who don't practice, the pores are clogged and it's difficult to cultivate.The spiritual energy between heaven and earth is integrated into the body. When you get older and your prime period passes, you will gradually age and lose your vitality. However, if you practice to the realm of a fighter, you can delay aging, strengthen your body, and prolong your life."

Yin Zhenluo knew that Xuanyuan was extremely confused about cultivating a discipline, so he explained it very carefully.

Xuanyuan had a very good understanding ability and understood immediately as soon as he heard it. Yin Zhenluo then continued:

"Only after the skin all over your body is made transparent and can absorb the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, can you step into the realm of a fighter and condense your fighting spirit. However, if you want to practice, you must have supernatural powers. Now I will pass on to you my Yin family's "Tianlong Scale Refining Technique". Take a good look at it and see how much you can understand!"

After saying that, Yin Zhenluo took out an extremely hard dragon scale in his hand, which was golden and covered with dense small characters.

After Xuanyuan took over the golden dragon scales, read the content on it, and started operating it, he suddenly felt as if there was a breath between heaven and earth breaking through his skin, and there was a slight tingling sensation.

Yin Zhenluo didn't expect Xuanyuan's comprehension ability to be so good. In less than an hour, he was already able to use the "Tianlong Scale Refining Technique" to communicate the aura between heaven and earth and attack the pores in his skin.

"Master Beauty, I can already feel it. My whole body is tingling and numb. Is that what it feels like?" Xuanyuan felt very magical and said excitedly.

"Yes, that's the feeling. Since you are the first disciple I teach, I can't treat you badly. This is the 'Dragon Scale Powder' that is extremely rare. Sprinkling these 'Dragon Scale Powder' on your body will help you break away the blockage of impurities in your pores as soon as possible, and it will also leave a trace of dragon scale breath on your skin." Yin Zhenluo took out a jade bottle and threw it to Xuanyuan.

Xuanyuan took the jade bottle and handed the golden dragon scales back to Yin Zhenluo. Yin Zhenluo just shook his head and said:

"Forget it, just think of this as a gift from me. It's of no use to me. This piece of dragon scale can be sold for a lot of money. I can't teach you for a long time, but if you want to sell this piece of dragon scale, remember to cross out the words above."

Since it was useless to Yin Zhenluo, Xuanyuan naturally accepted it with a clear conscience. Anyway, it is only natural for the master to give things to his disciples.

If Yin Zhenluo knew what Xuanyuan was thinking, she would probably be angry. Although the "Sky Dragon Scale Refining Technique" on this piece of dragon scale is no longer useful to her, the protective ability of this piece of dragon scale is still very good. Ordinary weapons cannot break its defense at all, so it is of great value.

After Xuanyuan stuffed the precious dragon scale into his chest, he grabbed the jade bottle containing the 'dragon scale powder', with a lewd smile:

"Master Beauty, can you help me apply it?"

Yin Zhenluo rolled her eyes and ignored Xuanyuan:

Xuanyuan nodded, not caring, and immediately took off his clothes in front of Yin Zhenluo, leaving him naked. Yin Zhenluo was forced to turn his head and turned halfway, only to see a few blushes on his beautiful face. After all, Yin Zhenluo was only two years older than Xuanyuan.

Looking at Yin Zhenluo's off-shoulder white silk dress, which accentuated her long neck, and her indescribably graceful figure, which gave people unlimited reverie, Xuanyuan swallowed a mouthful of saliva and said:

"Does this need to be applied to every part of the body?"

"Of course." Yin Zhenluo was angry and said to Xuanyuan in her heart: "This guy is really not ashamed."

Xuanyuan was naked and sprinkled the 'Dragon Scale Powder' in the jade bottle into his hands. He felt a coolness in his palms, which was extremely comfortable. It made Xuanyuan moan and squirt.

"Just apply it, why are you shouting?" Yin Zhenluo said angrily.

Just when Xuanyuan was feeling comfortable, when he heard what Yin Zhenluo said, he went crazy and became even more violent:

Yin Zhenluo trembled and was speechless. Xuanyuan smeared all over his body. He looked at his lower body, only this part was not smeared, and muttered:

"The skin here should also be refined. Well, just apply it."

Xuanyuan poured some "dragon scale powder" into his hand and applied it to his lower body. A cool and refreshing feeling spread throughout his body. Xuanyuan immediately became excited from the bottom of his heart.

"Ouch...oh...Ya Zhidie...Ya Zhidie..."

Listening to Xuanyuan's mother-in-law uttering several vague words that she didn't understand, the more Yin Zhenluo listened, the more she collapsed and wanted to beat Xuanyuan to death.

"If you dare to scream again, you will be dead." Yin Zhenluo's body trembled again and issued a warning.

Xuanyuan immediately shut up knowingly, put on his clothes quickly, sat cross-legged on the ground, and said with a sanctimonious look on his face:

"Master, I've finished wiping it. I'm going to start practicing. Don't disturb me."

Yin Zhenluo turned her head and looked at Xuanyuan's serious look. She was very angry. After glaring at Xuanyuan, she suddenly remembered something. She had a peerless face, a smile like a flower, and an indescribable brilliance. She looked like she was ready to watch a good show.

Xuanyuan closed his eyes, so he couldn't clearly see Yin Zhenluo's wonderful expression. He started to think of the "Tianlong Scale Refining Technique" in his heart. He only felt that the pores of his skin were opening and closing, and a lot of spiritual energy from heaven and earth washed towards him. A sharp tingling sensation spread throughout Xuanyuan's body.

Xuanyuan only felt that the pores on his body were torn open one by one, as if being pricked by needles.

Yin Zhenluo didn't expect that Xuanyuan was really tough. Although the 'Dragon Scale Powder' had an auxiliary effect, it had to endure pain like being pricked by needles. She had experienced it when she was a child. She had to grit her teeth to keep from screaming. Now Xuanyuan didn't even hum, which is really commendable.

As Xuanyuan moved the "Tianlong Scale Refining Technique" from top to bottom to his lower body, Xuanyuan's face suddenly darkened, he covered his lower body, twitched a few times, fell to the side, and cried out in pain:

"Master, my balls hurt, my balls hurt so much, my balls hurt so much..."
